full_judgment: I. Suit for simple partition without prayer for declaration of title and khas possession was not maintainable and there is "formal defect" in the suit and plaintiffs cannot succeed without removing "formal defect" and, as such, suit is liable to be withdrawn with permission to sue afresh.
